production.prompt: Stormwreck established auburn harpy. Entirely from directly behind, heading straight up screen, only back seen all 8 frames. One bone club in her left hand on screen left. Land onto an invisible perch, fold wings after talons touch in frame 6, absorb weight and settle in 7/8. Use the attached game art only for the character's established rendering and identity. Professional animation strip of one creature per cell. 4 columns × 2 rows exactly in chronological order, phase 1–4 on top and 5–8 below. Each creature stays in the center 65% of its own cell with very large transparent gutters, no pose may cross an imaginary cell edge. Wings compact if needed for margin. Fully opaque smooth character silhouettes and a genuinely transparent background, no gradient, backdrop, text, drop shadow, floor, outline or floating marks. All phases same size, costume and anatomy. Wide format 2:1.

review.technical: Native detail, cell clearance and distinct WEBP phases verified
review.visual: Reviewed for direction, silhouette, clear gutters and identity. Integrated map review recorded separately.
